annotations.title: Watch an event, company or market

description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Adds an event, edition, company, organizer, country (ISO code) or vertical (slug) to your workspace's "AI watches" list. Changes (new editions, new exhibitors or sponsors, speakers announced, score changes) arrive in the weekly email digest, and as signed webhooks on the Team plan and up. Watching the same thing twice changes nothing. Free plans watch 1 item, Pro 100, Team and Enterprise 500. Needs the 'atlas.reveal' permission.

id_or_slug.description: Slug or uuid from the search / get tools; an edition uuid from get_event; an ISO-3166 alpha-2 code for a country; a vertical slug.
